key: And God said: ‘Let us make man in our image, after our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.’
s: On the sixth day, after the land animals, God turns to making the human being; Rashi, on 1:26, reads the plural as humility: God consulted the angels, who had no part in the making, teaching that the greater should seek leave of the lesser.

evidence.gloss: The humility of the Holy One, blessed be He, is learned from here: because man is in the likeness of the angels and they would envy him, He therefore took counsel with them … Although they did not help Him in forming him, and it leaves room for heretics to rebel, the verse did not refrain from teaching proper conduct and the trait of humility, that the greater should consult and take leave of the lesser.
